methods.name: Apply
methods.description:
Create or update an organization.
 The authorization and state-operation are determined depending on whether the organization
 is going to be created or updated which is determined as part of the request execution.

methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Create a new organization
 No authorization required - any authenticated user can create an organization
 The creator automatically becomes the owner of the organization

methods.name: Update
methods.description:
Update an existing organization
 Requires: Organization admin permission (can_edit)

methods.name: Delete
methods.description:
Delete an organization
 Requires: Organization owner permission (can_delete)
 Note: This will cascade delete all resources under the organization

methods.name: Get
methods.description:
Get an organization by ID
 Requires: User must be a member of the organization (can_view)

methods.name: Find
methods.description:
Find organizations with pagination and filtering
 Requires: Platform admin permission
 This is for administrative purposes only

methods.name: FindMyOrganizations
methods.description:
Find organizations the authenticated user is a member of
 Authorization handled in handler via IAM Policy listAuthorizedResourceIds
 Returns only organizations the caller has access to

methods.name: GetByExternalOrgId
methods.description:
Look up a platform-managed organization by its external platform coordinates.
 Returns the Stigmer organization mapped to the given IdentityProvider + external org ID.
 Authorization: custom — checks can_view on the referenced IdentityProvider.
